title: Journey and Promise Map
purpose: Help children see Abraham’s movement and the promise’s widening purpose.
body_markdown:
# Journey and Promise Map

Draw or print a simple route from Haran to Canaan. Add these symbols:

- Land - a small map shape
- Family - a group of people
- Blessing - open hands
- All families - a large circle around the page

## Teacher key

The promise is not merely personal prosperity. Genesis 12:3 gives it a worldwide purpose.
